knowledge:
- key_parameters: version=STRING database version to use (e.g., "12.0") ;; species=NCBI taxonomy identifier of the organism (e.g., 9606 for Human, 10090 for Mouse) ;; score_threshold=Confidence score threshold for interactions (default is 400; interactions below this are ignored) ;; network_type="functional" for full functional STRING network or "physical" for physical subnetwork ;; link_data="detailed" to load evidence score columns (like experimental score) in addition to the combined score ;; input_directory=Local directory path to download and cache database files for offline use ;; backgroundV=Vector of STRING IDs representing the custom background set for hypergeometric enrichment tests ;; removeUnmappedRows=Logical parameter in map() to determine whether to discard unmapped input rows (default is TRUE)
- alternatives: igraph package (use get_graph() to retrieve the entire network as an igraph object for custom network analysis and search)
- when_to_use: When analyzing a list of genes or proteins (e.g., from differential expression analysis, RNA-seq, or microarrays) to discover functional associations, physical interactions, network clusters, or perform functional enrichment analysis (GO, KEGG, Reactome, etc.) using the STRING database.
- pitfalls: Failing to set a custom background gene list (set_background) when analyzing a predefined set of proteins (e.g., from a specific microarray platform), which leads to incorrect (overly optimistic) p-values in enrichment statistics ;; High percentages of unmapped genes during map() due to chromosome positions or non-standard gene symbols (e.g., "LOC" genes), which should be filtered out beforehand to improve mapping rates ;; KEGG terms are excluded from get_annotations() due to licensing issues, and PubMed terms are excluded due to output size.

workflows.name: protein_interaction_and_enrichment_analysis
workflows.intent: Map differentially expressed genes to the STRING database, visualize their interaction network with fold-change color coding, perform background-corrected functional enrichment, and identify network clusters.
input: gene_expression_data.csv (a table containing gene symbols, p-values, and log fold changes from a differential expression experiment)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize STRINGdb object with species and score threshold using STRINGdb$new ;; 2. Map gene symbols to STRING identifiers using string_db$map ;; 3. Filter mapped genes by p-value and select top hits ;; 4. Plot the protein-protein interaction network using string_db$plot_network ;; 5. Add differential expression colors based on log fold change using string_db$add_diff_exp_color ;; 6. Post payload to the STRING server using string_db$post_payload and plot the halo network ;; 7. Set custom background gene list using string_db$set_background ;; 8. Compute background-corrected functional enrichment using string_db$get_enrichment ;; 9. Generate and display enrichment figure using string_db$get_enrichment_figure ;; 10. Retrieve functional annotations using string_db$get_annotations ;; 11. Partition network into clusters using string_db$get_clusters and plot individual clusters ;; 12. Query specific protein interactions, partners, and homologs using string_db$mp, string_db$get_interactions, string_db$get_interaction_partners, string_db$get_paralogs, and string_db$get_homologs_besthits
workflows.code:
library(STRINGdb)
string_db <- STRINGdb$new( version="12.0", species=9606, 
                           score_threshold=400, network_type="full", link_data="detailed", input_directory="")
data(diff_exp_example1)
example1_mapped <- string_db$map( diff_exp_example1, "gene", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE )
example1_mapped_pval05 <- subset(example1_mapped, pvalue < 0.05)
example1_mapped_pval05 <- example1_mapped_pval05[order(example1_mapped_pval05$pvalue), ]
hits <- example1_mapped_pval05$STRING_id[1:200]
string_db$plot_network( hits )
example1_mapped_pval05 <- string_db$add_diff_exp_color( subset(example1_mapped, pvalue<0.05), 
                                                            logFcColStr="logFC" )    
payload_id <- string_db$post_payload( example1_mapped_pval05$STRING_id, 
                                        colors=example1_mapped_pval05$color )
string_db$plot_network( hits, payload_id=payload_id )
enrichment <- string_db$get_enrichment( hits )
enrichment_img <- string_db$get_enrichment_figure(
  hits,
  category = "Component",
  group_by_similarity = 0.8,
  color_palette = "yellow_pink",
  x_axis = "signal"
)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.raster(enrichment_img, interpolate = FALSE)
backgroundV <- example1_mapped$STRING_id
string_db$set_background(backgroundV)
enrichment_background_corrected <- string_db$get_enrichment( hits )
annotations <- string_db$get_annotations( hits )
clustersList <- string_db$get_clusters(example1_mapped_pval05$STRING_id[1:600])
string_db$plot_network(clustersList[[1]], add_summary = FALSE)
string_proteins <- string_db$get_proteins()
tp53 = string_db$mp( "tp53" )
atm = string_db$mp( "atm" )
string_db$get_interactions( c(tp53, atm) )
string_db$get_interaction_partners( c(tp53, atm), limit=5 )[, c("from", "to", "combined_score", "experimental", "from_name", "to_name")]
string_db$get_paralogs(tp53)
tp53_besthits <- string_db$get_homologs_besthits(tp53)
string_db$get_homologs_besthits(c(tp53, atm), target_species_id=10090)
